definitions.explanation: Animal skin that has been processed (tanned) for use in making goods such as bags, shoes, belts, and jackets.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{革|かわ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手触|てざわ}り→手触り：12758_tezawari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: This leather has a nice feel to it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本革|ほんがわ}→本革：16787_hongawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すれば→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{長持|ながも}ち→長持ち：14474_nagamochi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Genuine leather shoes last a long time if you take care of them.

notes:
Refers specifically to processed animal skin (leather), as distinct from ⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧ which means raw skin, hide, or peel. In practice, the two characters are sometimes used interchangeably, but the distinction matters in formal or technical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{本革|ほんがわ}→本革：16787_hongawa⟧ — genuine leather
- ⟦{合成|ごうせい}→合成：12027_gousei⟧{革|かわ} / {合皮|ごうひ} — synthetic leather
- ⟦{革|かわ}{製品|せいひん}→革製品：21272_kawaseihin⟧ — leather goods
- ⟦{革|かわ}{靴|ぐつ}→革靴：15433_kawagutsu⟧ — leather shoes
- {革|かわ}⟦ジャンパー→ジャンパー：05434_janpaa⟧ — leather jacket

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧: skin, hide, peel — raw/unprocessed skin; also used for fruit peel
- レザー: leather — English loanword used in fashion contexts
- {革|かわ} vs ⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧: {革|かわ} = tanned/processed leather; ⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧ = raw skin or covering. A cow has ⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧; a handbag is made of {革|かわ}
